Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Manish Kumar Nigam,J.
1.

The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to respondent no.2 and 3 not to pay compensation amount to respondent nos.4 to 8 for the land being acquired by them under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 till the decision of Civil Suit No.201 of 2023 and decide his objection dated 9.11.2023.
2.

sentences.text: On query made by the Court as to whether any award has been declared, counsel for the petitioner states that no award has been declared so far.

sentences.text: 3. In the aforesaid circumstances, we are of the opinion that the relief claimed is pre-mature as the cause of action would arise only after award is declared.
4. At this stage, the writ petitions stands dismissed.
